Reference / http/cookie_policy

http/cookie_policy#

Which cookies go where: domain and path matching (RFC 6265bis) and the context of a request.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

CookieDomainMatch(cookie: "example.com", request: "www.example.com", address: false).matches();  // true
CookiePathMatch(cookie: "/docs", request: "/docs/web").matches();                               // true
ParsedSetCookie(origin: field, url: url, reference: now).cookie();

Description#

Which cookies go where: domain and path matching (RFC 6265bis) and the context of a request.

The caller supplies the context (the site and whether the request is top-level); nothing here guesses a browser's frames. Cookie jars and CookieExchanging use these rules.

Public API#
